VECTA Workshop Pro V41.21 — 25 July 2026

SERVICE SHEETS
- Restored a reliable plain VECTA wordmark in red, bold and non-italic.
- Added a compact top row showing:
  - MOT due
  - Tax due
  - Next service due
  - Current service type
- The current service type also shows the next alternating service type.
- Existing saved service sheets are upgraded when opened, so the new header information appears on older records too.

MAJOR / MINOR SERVICE ALTERNATION
- Added Major Service and Minor Service preset job types.
- Completing a Major Service schedules a Minor Service 12 months later.
- Completing a Minor Service schedules a Major Service 12 months later.
- The matching Fleet Manager service plan is updated automatically.
- Fleet Manager quick-complete follows the same alternation.
- Booking a service from Fleet Manager carries the actual Major/Minor type into the job card.

RECURRING WORKSHOP TASKS
- Every Friday at 15:00 — Alfie: Clean & tidy workshop. Wash floor.
- Every Friday at 15:00 — Chris: Consumable inventory.
- Every Monday at 09:15 — Chris: Fill oil drums.
- Completing a recurring task creates its next weekly occurrence.
- Task cards display the assigned person, time and recurrence.

WORDMARK
- Restored VECTA at the top of the main application.
- Wordmark is plain red, bold and non-italic.

VALIDATION
- JavaScript syntax check passed.
- Browser test passed with no application errors.
- Major-to-Minor and Minor-to-Major scheduling were both tested.
- Service sheet visually checked at desktop and print layout size.
